description: This file defines the Ext.ux.grid.TableGrid class, which extends Ext.grid.GridPanel to create a grid component from an existing HTML table element. It includes constructor logic to set up data stores, column models, and configuration options, and appears to be part of the Ext JS library's user interface components.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.TableGrid
classes.description: A specialized grid panel that can be instantiated from an existing HTML table element, allowing for dynamic data binding and display within the Ext JS framework.

methods.name: Ext.ux.grid.TableGrid
methods.description: Constructor function that creates a grid from an existing HTML table, setting up data store, columns, sizes, and other configurations.
